executiveSummary: CivicState is a proposed paid civic-letter platform; investability remains unvalidated.
adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read planning corpus and master plan.
Read API, worker, frontend, payment route, submission route, researcher agent, and Prisma schema.
Searched for existing gate/native constitution artifacts before creating this file.

thesisCurrent.statement: CivicState may monetize abandoned civic intent by combining official lookup, citation-backed drafting, payment gating, and email delivery.
thesisCurrent.reason: Repo evidence supports product build surface, but not demand, deliverability, live coverage, or payment conversion.

honestyLabels.rule: Every quantitative claim in the soul is labeled as evidence or assumption.
honestyLabels.externalClaims: No external market claims are treated as evidence because network access was unavailable.
honestyLabels.factoryOutput: Planning and AI-generated artifacts are used only as repo evidence of intent/build history, not market proof.

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up proxy model, not sourced TAM.
marketSizing.tamProxy: 10,000,000 motivated residents [assumption: broad civic-action population] x 1.0 campaign/year [assumption] x $15 blended order value [assumption] = $150,000,000 annual gross spend [assumption: calculated].
marketSizing.samProxy: 1,000,000 SEO-reachable residents [assumption] x 1.0 campaign/year [assumption] x $15 blended order value [assumption] = $15,000,000 annual gross spend [assumption: calculated].
marketSizing.somTarget: 50,000 paid buyers/year [assumption] x 1.2 campaigns/year [assumption] x $15 blended order value [assumption] = $900,000 annual gross spend [assumption: calculated].
marketSizing.residualRisk: All sizing inputs require sourced research or first-party funnel data.

customerDefinition.primary: Individual U.S. resident with a concrete civic issue who will not complete official targeting, legal research, drafting, and delivery manually [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].
customerDefinition.excluded: Legal claimants, regulatory filers, private-party harassment targets, bulk campaign operators, and business-entity advocacy without separate policy review [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md].

revenueModel.deferred: Subscriptions, API access, certified mail, coalition features, and automated follow-up loops remain deferred [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md and .planning/GENESIS.md].

competition.gap: Current competitor feature/pricing/adoption details require network research.

goToMarket.planned: SEO-first through opt-in public campaign pages [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].
goToMarket.recommendedSequence: Concierge validation before indexed scale [assumption: risk-controlled validation sequence].

holes: No live deliverability evidence in workspace.
No sourced market-size evidence in workspace.
No operator ruling that this should pitch as a business.
mitigations: Run manual paid pilot before fundraising claims.
Run official-domain deliverability spike before public launch.
Replace market assumptions with sourced research or first-party metrics.
Keep gate status proposed until operator merge/adoption.
residualRisks: Demand may be weaker than the $5 to $25 price menu assumes [assumption: consumer willingness-to-pay unvalidated].
Government mail systems may suppress automated civic email.
Citation-backed letters may still be perceived as legal advice or spam.

antiPlan: Do not fund this as a venture business yet; prove demand, deliverability, official coverage, and compliance operations first.
assumptionLedger: Blended $15 order value [assumption: package mix unknown].
90.1% gross margin in scenario [assumption: depends on actual model, delivery, refund, and processing costs].
SEO can compound [assumption: no first-party search data in workspace].
One operator can manage review load [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md as intent; assumption as operating reality].

roadmap.shape: Buildable next steps with 7 checkbox items [evidence: ROADMAP.md]

registryNotes.sensitivity: personal/research asset, not near-term investible BOS unless operator confirms business pitch [evidence: dispatch registry notes]

surpriseSpikes: Dispatch project is brooks-history, but workspace product is CivicState [evidence: dispatch and .planning/PROJECT.md].
.planning/ROADMAP.md says all phases complete on 2026-04-25, while .planning/STATE.md says current focus is Phase 1 on 2026-04-25 [evidence: both files].
The requested VC-grade artifact conflicts with registry caution that the asset may not be near-term investible [evidence: dispatch registry notes].
